description: The declared exceptions of the runtime-guard check (#502, S32 of #470, ADR-0045): mhw runs one runtime, Node, and .github/scripts/runtime-guard.js fails on any other runtime's program in the tracked tree or in a workflow. Each entry names one tracked file, or one exact workflow line, and why it is not mhw's own code. An entry the check would not flag, or that names nothing, is stale and fails the check (test/ci/runtime-guard.test.js).
